author: visegrad24
text:
German political writer David Brough says he was beaten, insulted, ostracized and mistreated “every day” by Muslim classmates while attending school in Wuppertal, Western Germany, claiming they targeted him because he was German, gay and refused to “submit to Sharia.”

Brough says that when he reported homophobic attacks and abuse to a school guidance counselor, he was told: “David, we are a school of diversity. You just have to endure it. You have to tolerate other cultural conditions. And in Islam, being gay is haram, a sin.”

Calling his former school a “Sharia school,” Brough said that conditions in German schools have since become even worse and accused German politicians of abandoning children in the name of diversity, saying: “The worst part is that they sold out our children.”
